faq.title: Frequently Asked [[Questions]]
faq.subtitle: Tap a question to view the answer.
faq.q1: 1. How is the entry line managed on site, and what process should enrolled students follow?
faq.a1: On-site entry and wristband-holder entry lines are not separate. All enrolled students use the same entry line. However, enrolled students must verify their student status and receive an entry wristband before entering.
faq.q2: 2. If guests enter together with an enrolled student, can they enter the student-only zone?
faq.a2: Even when entering with an enrolled student, guests cannot use the student-only zone.
faq.q3: 3. Can someone wait in line for me or save a spot inside the main field area?
faq.a3: To maintain fair entry, proxy line-waiting and saving spots are not allowed. Reserving space with personal chairs or similar items, or bringing such items in, is also prohibited. All attendees must wait in line in person and use available space on site.
faq.q4: 4. Can I enter after the performance starts?
faq.a4: Wristband pickup and venue entry/exit are available from the entry start time until the end of that day's performance.
faq.q5: 5. Are there any restricted items when entering the main field?
faq.a5: For safety reasons, food and alcoholic beverages, professional cameras, and other items that may disturb others or pose a safety risk are restricted. Additional items may also be restricted depending on on-site conditions to ensure a safe and comfortable festival for all attendees.
faq.q6: 6. Can I leave, re-enter, or use the restroom during performances?
faq.a6: Temporary exit and re-entry for restroom use are allowed during performances. However, movement may be restricted during crowded periods, and returning to your previous spot may be difficult.
faq.q7: 7. Is there a separate seating area inside the main field?
faq.a7: There is no separate seating area inside the main field. For safety reasons, sitting on the floor or using picnic mats is not allowed.
faq.q8: 8. Where should I throw away trash?
faq.a8: Please use the designated trash bins outside the main field.
faq.q9: 9. Is there a capacity limit for viewing from the Emmaus Hall stands?
faq.a9: There is no fixed capacity limit, but entry may be restricted depending on on-site conditions and safety concerns.
faq.q10: 10. Where can I rent a picnic mat when viewing from the Emmaus Hall stands?
faq.a10: You can rent one at the picnic mat rental booth on the roof of Emmaus Hall.
faq.q11: 11. Can I take photos or videos of artists during performances?
faq.a11: General commemorative photos are allowed, but filming or recording with professional equipment, video recording, and live streaming on social media are prohibited because they may disturb others. Thank you for your cooperation.
faq.q12: 12. Are there designated smoking areas during the festival?
faq.a12: Smoking is allowed only in designated smoking areas. Please use existing smoking areas, such as those next to the Main Hall and behind the gymnasium.
faq.q13: 13. Where can I find lost items?
faq.a13: After the festival, lost items will be collected by the Festival Preparation Committee and announced separately through a post on the committee's official Instagram (@sogang_festival).
faq.q14: 14. Will a medical team be on standby? If so, where?
faq.a14: During the festival, EMS will be on standby near the main field entrance. In case of an emergency, please inform the nearest staff member so they can respond quickly.
faq.q15: 15. Where can I pick up pre-purchased goods?
faq.a15: Pre-purchased goods can be picked up at the goods booth in Youth Plaza. On-site sales will be operated at the sales booth next to the main field entrance. Please check the campus map in the app for detailed locations.
